title: Choosing a shard key and avoiding hot shards

kcs.statement: A good shard key has high cardinality, spreads load evenly and matches the dominant access pattern so most queries touch a single shard.
A skewed shard key, such as a celebrity's user_id or the current date, sends most traffic to one shard; fixes include salting the key with a suffix or splitting that key's data across shards.
Queries that do not filter on the shard key must scatter to every shard and gather the results, and joins or transactions across shards need application logic.
